claim: § The same object as a loop + Forward Vector: a stored cycle read by a counter and the same cycle going round a lossless delay loop are one object; subtract them at a whole-sample period and silence is the proof.

pieces.section: The same object as a loop
pieces.what: Play a cycle from a table and the same cycle round a delay loop, then flip one's polarity and sum: silence at whole-sample periods, a residue in between until the fractional filter is switched on.

pieces.section: Why it can only be harmonic
pieces.what: Loop one cycle of a bell and hear the loop's harmonics, not the bell; the spectrum shows the bell's partials snapped to the grid.
Sweep Position slowly, then drive it fast at a rate unrelated to pitch: harmonics change strength, then sidebands leave the lattice as Position becomes a second clock.
pieces.walks_up_from: a two-frame table with a Position knob
